# ANOMALY-RAW

> ANOMALY-RAW is a cyber-industrial streetwear brand built around glitch aesthetics, corrupted interfaces, technical codes, digital noise and underground visual culture.

## Brand

- Official site: https://anomaly-raw.vercel.app/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/anomaly.rw/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@anomalyrw
- Redbubble: https://www.redbubble.com/people/anomaly-raw

## Drop 01 — RAW SIGNAL

Drop 01 contains five original ANOMALY-RAW design units. Each landing page describes the design and links directly to its current Redbubble product page.

- AR-01 — Digital Anomaly Scan: https://anomaly-raw.vercel.app/drop-01/ar-01/
- AR-02 — System Error: https://anomaly-raw.vercel.app/drop-01/ar-02/
- AR-03 — Signal Disturbed: https://anomaly-raw.vercel.app/drop-01/ar-03/
- AR-04 — Data Corrupted: https://anomaly-raw.vercel.app/drop-01/ar-04/
- AR-05 — Limited Issue: https://anomaly-raw.vercel.app/drop-01/ar-05/

## Style

Cyber-industrial, glitch-inspired, raw, minimal, technical, underground streetwear.

## Shopping

Products, available formats, sizes, colors and live pricing are provided by Redbubble on the relevant product page.
